agm.agm_result:
Agenda #1: Shareholders approved the 2025 Annual Report, Financial Statements, and Board of Commissioners' Oversight Report, granting a full discharge of liability to the Directors and Commissioners. This approval was passed with 100% of valid votes on May 21, 2026.
Agenda #2: The meeting approved allocating IDR 100,000,000 of the 2025 net profit to mandatory reserves, with no dividend distribution and the remaining balance added to retained earnings. This decision was approved by 100% of valid votes.
Agenda #3: The Board of Commissioners was authorized to appoint a Public Accounting Firm for the 2026 fiscal year audit and determine the associated honorarium and terms. The Board of Directors will assist in setting the specific fees.
Agenda #4: The company reported that IPO proceeds were fully utilized by 2025, while IDR 14.8 billion from Series I Warrant conversions remains available for use in 2026. This report was submitted to the OJK via letter on January 14, 2026.
Agenda #5: Shareholders accepted the resignation of Director Bambang Susilo and approved the appointment of Yulius C. Rusli and Viko Setiyawan as new Directors. These changes became effective upon the closing of the meeting.
Agenda #6: The Board of Commissioners was granted authority to determine the salaries, honorariums, and allowances for the Board of Directors and Commissioners for the 2026 financial year. This determination will follow recommendations from the Nomination and Remuneration Committee.

agm.agm_result:
Agenda #1: Approval of feasibility study presentation on changes to business activities. The meeting approved and accepted the presentation of the Feasibility Study concerning the Company's plan to expand into new business activities and supporting business activities, prepared in compliance with Financial Services Authority Regulation No. 17/POJK.04/2020.
Agenda #2: Approval of amendment to Article 3 of the Articles of Association regarding purpose and business activities. The meeting approved adding new business activities with specific KBLI codes (46511, 46512, 58200, 62015, 62019, 62090, 63111) and the amendment to Article 3.
Agenda #3: Adjustment of business activities according to KBLI 2025. The meeting approved the adjustment and alignment of all primary and supporting business activities to comply with KBLI 2025 codification, and granted authority to the Board of Directors to execute the changes.
Agenda #4: Approval of granting authority to Board members to incorporate resolution into Notarial Deed. The resolution authorizes each Board member, with substitution rights, to appear before a notary, sign deeds and documents, and notify authorities to implement the resolution.
